facts.fact: The Direction generale du Domaine national announced on 11 January 2026 the generalisation of the Amlak information system, a unified national system with a central database integrating the cadastre, land conservation and State Domains, with immediate response to requests at cadastre and land conservation counters.
The Direction generale du Domaine national said Amlak was generalised to all directorates of the cadastre, land conservation and State Domains.
